name: How long does a kitchen countertop replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen countertop replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen countertop swap takes about one to two weeks from template to completion, with on-site installation lasting just one to two days. However, the exact timeline depends heavily on cabinet readiness and material selection. Templating cannot take place until all lower cabinets are permanently fastened in place. After measuring, off-site cutting and fabrication generally take several days to two weeks. Once the slab is anchored in your home, the adhesives need 24 hours to cure before a licensed plumber can reconnect the faucet and disposal or before tile installers can begin laying wall tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fabrication takes about one to two weeks after measuring, while physical installation takes one to two days. Adhesives cure for 24 hours before plumbing lines and backsplashes can be finished.
